title: Israel Releases List of 170 Alleged Militants Killed as Journalists
detail: Israel released a list of 170 people killed in Gaza it claims were militants deliberately posing as media workers, directly challenging international reporting on journalist casualties in the conflict. The release seeks to reframe international records of journalist deaths compiled by CPJ and RSF, which have documented Gaza as the deadliest conflict for journalists on record.

media.caption: Israel releases list of 170 alleged militants it claims posed as journalists in Gaza
